blocks.text: Bacteria aur archaea prokaryotic cells se bane hain, jabke zindagi ki baqi tamam shaklein eukaryotic cells se bani hain. Prokaryotic aur eukaryotic dono cells mein genetic mawad (material) DNA hai; dono ki plasma membranes un ka ghilaf (covering) hain; aur dono mein protein synthesis ke liye ribosomes hain. Aap cell organelles ki tafseel pehle parh chuke hain.

Prokaryotic cells eukaryotic cells se kahin saada (simpler) hain. Zyada tar prokaryotic cells 2 se 8 µm lambe hote hain, yani ek aam eukaryotic cell ke size ka taqreeban daswan hissa. Prokaryotic cell mein nucleus nahin hota: us ka kahin kam DNA kam-o-besh darmiyani hisse mein hota hai jise nucleoid (nucleus jaisa) kehte hain. Prokaryotic cell mein doosre membrane mein band organelles, jaise endoplasmic reticulum, mitochondria, chloroplasts, Golgi apparatus, lysosomes aur peroxisomes, bhi nahin hote. Poora cytoplasm ek ikai hai jis mein andaruni sahare ki koi banawat nahin. Ribosomes maujood hain magar eukaryotic cells ke ribosomes se chhote.

blocks.alt: Lambai mein khula chhari (rod) ki shakal ka bacterium. Bahar se andar: nuqtedar capsule, moti cell wall, patli cell membrane, aur cytoplasm jis mein circular DNA ka uljha nucleoid, ek chhota circular plasmid, bikhre ribosomes aur membrane ki do mesosome tehain hain. Ek sire se lehradar flagellum nikla hai aur satah se chhote pili ubhre hain.
blocks.caption: Ek aam prokaryotic cell (asal diagram, Chapter 2 ke saath mushtarak, Figure 3.29 ke mutabiq).
blocks.long_description: Prokaryotic cell mein capsule, peptidoglycan ki cell wall aur plasma membrane hai. Nucleus nahin hai: circular DNA nucleoid mein hai, aur plasmids naami chhote izafi halqe bhi. 70S ribosomes cytoplasm mein azaad bikhre hain; membrane mein band organelles nahin hain. Pili jurne ke liye ubhaar hain aur flagellin ka bana flagellum harkat ke liye hai.

blocks.text: Prokaryotic ribosomes ke chhote aur bare subunits ki Svedberg values 30S aur 50S hain, aur mukammal ribosome 70S hai. Zyada tar prokaryotic cells ki plasma membrane ke gird cell wall hoti hai, magar is mein cellulose nahin: yeh peptidoglycan se bani hai, jo amino acids aur sugar ka ek bara polymer hai. Bacteria mein cell wall ke gird capsule bhi ho sakta hai aur jurne ke liye ubhaar, pili (wahid pilus), bhi. Prokaryotic flagella protein flagellin ki dohrai hui ikaiyon se bane hain aur un mein microtubule triplets nahin hote. Prokaryotic cell mein mitosis aur meiosis nahin hote; yeh seedhi taqseem (binary fission) se taqseem hota hai.

blocks.alt: Side view mein bacterial flagellum: cell envelope ki tahon mein jami rings ki basal body, ek khameeda hook, aur bahar ko phaila lamba helical filament.
blocks.caption: Prokaryotic flagellum, flagellin ka bana, microtubules ke baghair (asal diagram, Chapter 2 ke saath mushtarak; topic 3.4 ke 9 + 2 axoneme se muqabla karen, Figure 3.30 ke mutabiq).
blocks.long_description: Prokaryotic flagellum protein flagellin ka sakht helical filament hai, jo hook ke zariye rings ki basal body se jura hai jo cell envelope mein ghoomti hai. Yeh membrane mein band nahin aur is mein microtubules nahin, eukaryotic flagellum ke bar-aks, jo membrane se dhaka axoneme hai jis mein nau doublets ke andar do markazi microtubules hain.

blocks.prompt: Teen khususiyat batayen jo mitochondria prokaryotic cells ke saath share karte hain, aur teen tareeqe jin mein prokaryotic cell eukaryotic cell se mukhtalif hai.
blocks.explanation: Mitochondria aur prokaryotes dono mein circular DNA, 70S ribosomes hain aur dono taqseem se azaad replicate kar sakte hain. Prokaryotic cell mein nucleus nahin (nucleoid hai), membrane mein band organelles nahin (ER, mitochondria, Golgi, lysosomes nahin), chhote 70S ribosomes, peptidoglycan wall, flagellin ke flagella, aur yeh mitosis ya meiosis ki bajaye binary fission se taqseem hota hai; yeh taqreeban das guna chhota bhi hai.

items: Dono cell qismon mein DNA, plasma membrane aur ribosomes hain; prokaryotes (bacteria, archaea) 1-10 µm, eukaryotes 10-100 µm.
Prokaryotes: nucleus ki jagah nucleoid, plasmids, membrane mein band organelles nahin, 70S ribosomes (30S + 50S), peptidoglycan wall, capsule aur pili, flagellin ke flagella, binary fission.
Eukaryotes: bohat se chromosomes wala sahi nucleus, ER, Golgi, mitochondria, lysosomes, peroxisomes, cytoskeleton, 80S ribosomes, microtubule wale flagella, mitosis aur meiosis.
